scope: Exact additional Go module sources and original notices, fixed project Caddy build inputs, Alpine/musl JRE recipe and source changes, the two changed Java runtime dependency sources, and bundled GNU libgcc 12.4 source/build/notice supplements for 0.1.3. The GNU runtime supplement also covers the identical libgcc bytes in the retained v0.1.2 Agent. Other unchanged dependencies and historical components retain their original v0.1.2 source/notice archives. Contains no standalone application executable or deployment secrets.
